assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE final square original fantasy game addon avatar for Target Ranger. Subject: an elegant curved wooden hunting bow with one steel-tipped arrow, over a round brass rangefinder dial with simple tick marks and a glowing green central target ring. No numerals on the dial. Consistent family design with the previously created Titan Gathered and Command History emblems: tactile hand-painted classic fantasy inventory artwork, dark midnight blue background, antique gold square bevel frame with restrained clipped corners inset 5 percent. Strong simple central silhouette fills 75 percent. Bold polished highlights, readable as a 64x64 game icon. Square 1024x1024. No letters, text, numerals, wordmarks, watermark, existing game or company logos. Single emblem, no collage.
